sentences.japanese: くすぶっていた薪が突然燃え上がった。
sentences.english: The smoldering firewood burst into flame.

sentences.japanese: 薪が足りず、はやくも火勢が衰えはじめた暖炉。
sentences.english: The fireplace, lacking firewood, flames already starting to lose their vigour.

sentences.japanese: 彼は椅子を叩き壊して薪にした。
sentences.english: He broke up the chair for firewood.

sentences.japanese: もう一本、暖炉に薪をくべて。
sentences.english: Put another log in the fireplace.

sentences.japanese: トムは薪を割ってるよ。
